quickAnswerTitle: Quick Answer: How to Style a Cuban Collar Shirt?
quickAnswer: Style a Cuban collar shirt with tapered linen trousers, pleated chinos or relaxed cotton pants. Wear it untucked when the hem is designed for that length, or tuck it into tailored trousers for a cleaner look. Complete the outfit with suede loafers, espadrilles or minimalist leather sneakers. Choose a fit that sits cleanly at the shoulders and allows easy movement without pulling across the chest.
intro: Few garments capture warm-weather sartorial ease like the Cuban collar shirt. Its open, relaxed collar and simple styling make it a versatile choice for summer dressing, from weekends to informal evening occasions. The guide below explains the collar, fit, fabric and outfit choices so you can wear one with intention rather than treating it as a holiday-only piece.

sections.heading: 1. What Is a Cuban Collar Shirt?
paragraphs: A Cuban collar shirt is a button-front shirt with a soft, open collar that lies flat and creates a notch-like shape at the neckline. Unlike a conventional dress shirt collar, it usually has no stiff collar stand extending around the neck. The result is a relaxed frame for the neck that can be worn open without a tie.

The style is often called a camp collar shirt. Designs vary in collar shape, placket, fabric and sleeve length, so look at the garment itself rather than assuming every shirt with a similar name has the same construction.

sections.heading: 2. Cuban Collar vs Camp Collar: Are They the Same?
paragraphs: In modern menswear, Cuban collar and camp collar are often used for the same open, soft-collar shirt style. Some retailers and wearers use Cuban collar to describe the more distinctly notched, resort-inspired look, while camp collar can refer more broadly to a relaxed shirt collar that lies open. There is no single naming convention across every brand.

When comparing a Cuban collar vs camp collar shirt, focus on the collar's shape and how it sits rather than the label. Both are generally casual, worn open at the neck and easy to pair with warm-weather fabrics.

sections.heading: 3. Fabric Selection: Linen, Cotton and Drapey Blends
paragraphs: Choose fabric according to the weather and the silhouette you want. Linen offers an airy feel and a naturally textured surface; cotton poplin or voile can feel crisp and light; rayon or lyocell blends often drape fluidly. The weight and weave matter as much as the fibre name, and a soft fabric helps the collar fall naturally.

A crisp, structured cotton can still work if the collar holds its shape and the shirt suits your style. Consider how the fabric feels against the skin, how much texture you want and whether its care requirements fit your routine.

bullets.label: Linen
bullets.text: Textured and relaxed, a natural choice for warm days and casual evenings.

bullets.label: Cotton
bullets.text: Available in crisp or soft constructions for versatile everyday wear.

bullets.label: Rayon or lyocell blends
bullets.text: Often chosen for a smooth hand and fluid drape; check the garment care label.

sections.heading: 4. How Should a Cuban Collar Shirt Fit?
paragraphs: A Cuban collar shirt should feel relaxed without looking oversized by accident. The shoulder seams should sit near your natural shoulder line, and the chest should allow you to move without pulling across the buttons. The collar should lie comfortably and symmetrically rather than gaping or collapsing awkwardly.

For an untucked look, choose a hem made to be worn out: it should fall around the mid-fly and not extend so far that it overwhelms your proportions. If you plan to tuck the shirt in, check that the body has enough length to stay in place. Sleeve length and width are matters of preference, but the sleeves should not restrict movement.
bullets: Shoulders: seams sit close to the edge of your shoulders without drooping far down the arm.
Chest: buttons lie flat when you move and breathe normally.
Body: choose a length that works for your intended tucked or untucked styling.
Collar: it rests naturally and keeps its open shape without feeling tight.

sections.heading: 5. How to Pair a Cuban Collar Shirt with Trousers and Shoes
paragraphs: Pair an ecru or sage Cuban collar shirt with olive chinos, relaxed pleated trousers or lightweight linen pants. For an easy casual outfit, try a solid shirt with straight-leg cotton trousers or dark denim. Keep the proportions balanced: a relaxed shirt works well with a clean trouser line, while a fuller trouser can suit a shirt with a neater fit.

Choose footwear to match the occasion. Suede loafers or espadrilles keep the outfit relaxed; leather sandals suit informal warm-weather settings; clean low-profile sneakers give it a modern casual finish. For more trouser color ideas, see [our guide to shirts with olive green pants](https://shirtsmeer.com/blog/what-color-shirt-goes-with-olive-green-pants).

sections.heading: 6. Can You Wear a Cuban Collar Shirt to Work or a Wedding?
paragraphs: A Cuban collar shirt can work for a relaxed office if the dress code allows open-collar, casual shirts. Choose a restrained colour or print, a neat fit and tailored trousers; skip it when the workplace expects conventional business dress or a tie.

For a wedding, follow the invitation and venue. A plain or subtle-patterned shirt with tailored trousers and a lightweight jacket can suit an informal daytime or warm-weather celebration. It is usually too casual for black tie or a formal dress code. When in doubt, ask the host or choose a more traditional shirt.

sections.heading: 7. Wear It Open, Layered or Tucked
paragraphs: The open collar is part of the shirt's character, so leave the top buttons undone rather than fastening it to the throat. Wear the shirt on its own for a simple warm-weather outfit, or layer it open over a plain tee or tank when the setting and fabric suit that look.

An untucked hem is an easy choice when the shirt is cut to that length. A Cuban collar shirt can also be tucked into higher-rise tailored trousers for a sharper silhouette; use a belt if it completes the outfit. Avoid forcing an untucked look with a long dress-shirt hem.

faqs.question: What is a Cuban collar shirt?
faqs.answer: It is a button-front shirt with a soft, open collar that lies flat and forms a notch-like shape at the neckline. It is usually worn open without a tie and is also commonly called a camp collar shirt.

faqs.question: Are Cuban collar and camp collar shirts the same?
faqs.answer: The terms are often used interchangeably for a relaxed, open collar that lies flat. Naming varies between brands, so compare the actual collar shape and construction rather than relying only on the product name.

faqs.question: How should a Cuban collar shirt fit?
faqs.answer: Look for a comfortable shoulder fit, enough room to move without the chest buttons pulling, and a collar that lies naturally. For an untucked outfit, choose a hem designed to be worn out rather than a long dress-shirt tail.

faqs.question: What pants and shoes go with a Cuban collar shirt?
faqs.answer: Try chinos, linen trousers, pleated cotton pants or straight-leg jeans. Suede loafers, espadrilles and clean low-profile sneakers all work; choose shoes that suit the formality and setting.

faqs.question: Can you wear a Cuban collar shirt to work?
faqs.answer: Yes, in a relaxed or business-casual workplace that permits open-collar shirts. Choose a restrained colour or print and tailored trousers. It is not a substitute for a formal dress shirt where the dress code requires one.

faqs.question: Can you wear a Cuban collar shirt to a wedding?
faqs.answer: It can suit an informal daytime or warm-weather wedding when the invitation allows casual tailoring. Pair a neat, understated shirt with tailored trousers, and avoid it for black tie or other formal dress codes.

faqs.question: Should you wear an undershirt with a Cuban collar?
faqs.answer: It is optional. Many wear the shirt directly against the skin; an open shirt layered over a simple, close-fitting tee or tank can also work when the fabric and occasion suit the look.

faqs.question: Can you wear a Cuban collar shirt with a suit?
faqs.answer: For an informal summer event, an open Cuban collar shirt can work with an unstructured linen or cotton suit. Check the event dress code first; this pairing is not appropriate for formal or black-tie occasions.
